#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install the already received ReturnBy completion build as a separate Mac copy.

The supplied archive is pinned to the original ten qualified assets. No build,
package download, existing installation, browser profile, or server is touched.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shlex
import stat
import sys
import zipfile

SOURCE_COMMIT = "83abbe9a00a5169354df25c734c00340ae73ae43"
SOURCE_TREE = "cfd56ce9960f08c4f5983d5a7a3ca054373f34c8"
ARCHIVE_SHA256 = "816e8d09fbecc27ffeb189aa3c889e48e5bc81f352ccc5b75f5cb9bd64badd71"
ARCHIVE_BYTES = 260719
MANIFEST_SHA256 = "5bf81ba20fd4c12732661f0008c09ca71095176d72b373b04f4767c73fb75a83"
ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256 = "7fa92cf4a00072c714e7367feb09fb7f7e2eaa39cf62c9bbef180b303b6191a2"
INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256 = "d2bbfaa4440d639bf20e37bc9b0fc3e20d01c643609f1af11d49a57b27e37ac2"
INSTALLED_SERVER_BYTES = 5744
SUPPORT_NAMES = {"ASSETS.json", "PROVENANCE.json", "serve_returnby.py", "START-HERE.md"}
ENTRY_NAME = "Start ReturnBy.command"

MAC_GUIDE = """# ReturnBy on this Mac

Double-click **Start ReturnBy.command** and keep its terminal open. Open either
address printed in the terminal:

- Tracker: http://127.0.0.1:8769/index.html
- Printable trip checklist: http://127.0.0.1:8769/trip-checklist.html

When finished, **press Enter in that terminal**. Closing input also stops the
server. Starting this copy installs no service and opens no browser automatically.
Use the same browser and address on subsequent openings to keep this copy's data.
If the address is occupied, this copy refuses to start; close its earlier terminal
and try again. It never chooses a different port or replaces another process.
On macOS, reopening after closing can wait up to 60 seconds for the local address
to become available. Keep the terminal open until the addresses are printed, or
press Ctrl+C to cancel startup. If that wait expires, inspect the reported error
and explicitly try again later.

## Use the tracker and checklist

Review an order before saving its deadline. Mark a finished return completed to
keep its history without listing it in a new trip. Reopen preserves its original
reviewed details and deadline. Open the separate checklist address, select open
orders, review the planned trip, and download the printable HTML. After a saved
change, explicitly refresh and reselect. A sheet already downloaded or printed
cannot be recalled. The tracker has no added checklist navigation link.

This exact received composition uses its own origin. It does not read data from
the hosted site or the older Mac manual-receipt copy at port 48643. To transfer
records, use the existing tracker Backup/Restore actions, review the preview,
and confirm deliberately. Browser storage is not copied by this installation.

## Verify and recover

Run the retained installer with `--check` and this folder's path to check the
original archive, all ten built assets, both runtime copies, original server,
launcher, and installation pins. Run these commands from this folder:

    python3 recovery/install_macos.py --check "/path/to/this/folder"

To make a fresh copy, choose a destination that does not already exist:

    python3 recovery/install_macos.py --archive recovery/received-build.zip \\
      --destination "/Users/me/Applications/ReturnBy-Completion-Recovered"

The installer requires macOS and Python 3.12 or later, records the interpreter
actually used, and installs no dependency. Existing destinations are never
overwritten. The launcher resolves its own folder, including spaces. Only one
copy can use the fixed origin at a time. The original Windows instructions and
qualified transfer are preserved under `recovery/`. A failed installation may
leave a partial destination: keep it for inspection and choose another new path.
The installer never removes a partial copy or repairs an existing destination.

## Source and receiving

Application source: Jacob-Met/returnby PR37, commit
83abbe9a00a5169354df25c734c00340ae73ae43, tree
cfd56ce9960f08c4f5983d5a7a3ca054373f34c8. The ten application assets are unchanged
from the independently received MSI package. This V2 installation uses a
separately verified foreground runtime in `serve_returnby.py` and retains an
identical copy beside the recovery installer. The original archive is unchanged;
its original runtime is preserved as `recovery/original-serve_returnby.py`.
`INSTALLATION.json` records separate original and installed runtime hashes.
`PROVENANCE.json` preserves the original authors, results, failures, and limits.
The new Mac entry and focused receiving have separate receipts. Existing
project owners retain wider stack composition and hosted adoption.
"""


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def read_regular(path: Path, max_bytes: int) -> bytes:
    if not stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode):
        raise ValueError(f"Expected a regular file: {path}")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        data = stream.read(max_bytes + 1)
    if len(data) > max_bytes:
        raise ValueError(f"File is too large: {path.name}")
    return data


def admit_archive(path: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes], list[dict]]:
    archive = read_regular(path, ARCHIVE_BYTES)
    if len(archive) != ARCHIVE_BYTES or digest(archive) != ARCHIVE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("The supplied archive is not the pinned received ReturnBy build.")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as bundle:
        names = bundle.namelist()
        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
            raise ValueError("The received archive contains duplicate paths.")
        manifest_bytes = bundle.read("ASSETS.json")
        if digest(manifest_bytes) != MANIFEST_SHA256:
            raise ValueError("The asset manifest does not match this release.")
        assets = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
        expected = SUPPORT_NAMES | {"app/" + item["path"] for item in assets}
        if set(names) != expected or len(assets) != 10:
            raise ValueError("The received archive has an unexpected file set.")
        files = {name: bundle.read(name) for name in names}
    for item in assets:
        data = files["app/" + item["path"]]
        if len(data) != item["bytes"] or digest(data) != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("A received application asset changed: " + item["path"])
    if digest(files["serve_returnby.py"]) != ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("The original foreground server changed.")
    provenance = json.loads(files["PROVENANCE.json"])
    if provenance["product"] != SOURCE_COMMIT or provenance["product_tree"] != SOURCE_TREE:
        raise ValueError("The original source identity does not match.")
    return archive, files, assets


def admit_runtime(path: Path) -> bytes:
    runtime = read_regular(path, INSTALLED_SERVER_BYTES)
    if len(runtime) != INSTALLED_SERVER_BYTES or digest(runtime) != INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("The replacement foreground server does not match this installer.")
    return runtime


def launcher(python: str) -> bytes:
    return ("#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\n"
            'RETURNBY_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)\n'
            f'exec {shlex.quote(python)} -B "$RETURNBY_DIR/serve_returnby.py" "$@"\n').encode()


def installed_name(name: str) -> str:
    if name in {"START-HERE.md", "serve_returnby.py"}:
        return "recovery/original-" + name
    return name


def check_installation(destination: Path) -> dict:
    archive, files, assets = admit_archive(destination / "recovery/received-build.zip")
    receipt = json.loads(read_regular(destination / "INSTALLATION.json", 16384))
    if (not isinstance(receipt, dict)
            or receipt.get("schema") != "returnby-macos-received-preview-v2"
            or receipt.get("sourceCommit") != SOURCE_COMMIT
            or receipt.get("sourceTree") != SOURCE_TREE
            or receipt.get("archiveSha256") != ARCHIVE_SHA256
            or receipt.get("originalServerSha256") != ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256
            or receipt.get("installedServerSha256") != INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256
            or not isinstance(receipt.get("python"), str)):
        raise ValueError("The installation receipt does not match this release.")
    expected = {installed_name(name): data for name, data in files.items()}
    runtime = admit_runtime(destination / "serve_returnby.py")
    expected["serve_returnby.py"] = runtime
    expected["recovery/serve_returnby.py"] = runtime
    expected[ENTRY_NAME] = launcher(receipt["python"])
    expected["START-HERE.md"] = MAC_GUIDE.encode()
    for name, data in expected.items():
        if read_regular(destination / name, len(data)) != data:
            raise ValueError("An installed file changed: " + name)
    installer = read_regular(destination / "recovery/install_macos.py", 32768)
    if digest(installer) != receipt.get("installerSha256"):
        raise ValueError("The retained installer changed.")
    if not os.access(destination / ENTRY_NAME, os.X_OK):
        raise ValueError("The Mac launcher is not executable.")
    return {"schema": "returnby-macos-received-preview-check-v2", "accepted": True,
            "destination": str(destination), "sourceCommit": SOURCE_COMMIT,
            "sourceTree": SOURCE_TREE, "archiveSha256": digest(archive),
            "assetsVerified": len(assets), "originalServerSha256": ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256,
            "installedServerSha256": INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256,
            "origin": "http://127.0.0.1:8769", "python": receipt["python"]}


def install(archive_path: Path, destination: Path) -> dict:
    if sys.platform != "darwin" or sys.version_info < (3, 12):
        raise ValueError("Install using Python 3.12 or later on the intended Mac.")
    archive, files, _ = admit_archive(archive_path)
    installer_path = Path(__file__)
    runtime = admit_runtime(installer_path.with_name("serve_returnby.py"))
    installer = read_regular(installer_path, 32768)
    python = str(Path(sys.executable).absolute())
    # mkdir is the no-overwrite operation. A concurrent creator wins safely.
    # Payloads and receipt precede the executable entry. A write failure can
    # leave a partial destination; no rollback or overwrite is attempted.
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    output = {installed_name(name): data for name, data in files.items()}
    output.update({"serve_returnby.py": runtime,
                   "recovery/serve_returnby.py": runtime,
                   "recovery/received-build.zip": archive,
                   "recovery/install_macos.py": installer,
                   "START-HERE.md": MAC_GUIDE.encode()})
    for name, data in output.items():
        target = destination / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with target.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
    receipt = {"schema": "returnby-macos-received-preview-v2", "sourceCommit": SOURCE_COMMIT,
               "sourceTree": SOURCE_TREE, "archiveSha256": ARCHIVE_SHA256,
               "originalServerSha256": ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256,
               "installedServerSha256": INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256,
               "installerSha256": digest(installer), "python": python,
               "pythonVersion": platform.python_version(), "machine": platform.machine(),
               "origin": "http://127.0.0.1:8769"}
    with (destination / "INSTALLATION.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
    with (destination / ENTRY_NAME).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(launcher(python))
    (destination / ENTRY_NAME).chmod(0o755)
    return check_installation(destination)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--destination", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--check", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check is not None:
        if args.archive is not None or args.destination is not None:
            parser.error("--check cannot be combined with installation arguments")
        action = lambda: check_installation(args.check.expanduser().absolute())
    elif args.archive is None or args.destination is None:
        parser.error("supply both --archive and a new --destination, or use --check")
    else:
        action = lambda: install(args.archive.expanduser().absolute(), args.destination.expanduser().absolute())
    try:
        print(json.dumps(action(), indent=2))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        print("ReturnBy installation refused: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
tests/received_preview/test_install_maco:
"""Focused installer receiving; point RETURNBY_RECEIVED_ARCHIVE at the pinned ZIP.

On a non-Mac host only the installer platform precondition is simulated. Actual
shell/HTTP execution retains that host's identity and is not Mac acceptance.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import urlopen

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("returnby_mac_install", ROOT / "tools/received_preview/install_macos.py")
installer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(installer)
ARCHIVE = os.environ.get("RETURNBY_RECEIVED_ARCHIVE")
NATIVE_MAC = sys.platform == "darwin"


def inventory(path: Path) -> dict:
    return {str(item.relative_to(path)): hashlib.sha256(item.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for item in path.rglob("*") if item.is_file()}


@unittest.skipUnless(ARCHIVE, "Supply the exact received archive through RETURNBY_RECEIVED_ARCHIVE")
class ReceivedMacEntry(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ReturnBy receiver é ")
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.destination = self.root / "ReturnBy completion copy"
        with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
            self.receipt = installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), self.destination)
        self.processes = []

    def tearDown(self):
        for child in self.processes:
            if child.poll() is None:
                child.terminate()
                try:
                    child.communicate(timeout=6)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    child.kill()
                    child.communicate(timeout=6)
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def start(self, *args):
        child = subprocess.Popen([str(self.destination / installer.ENTRY_NAME), *args],
                                 stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                 text=True, encoding="utf-8")
        self.processes.append(child)
        return child

    def wait_ready(self, child):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + (65 if NATIVE_MAC else 10)
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if child.poll() is not None:
                self.fail("Entry exited before readiness: " + repr(child.communicate()))
            try:
                with urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8769/index.html", timeout=1) as response:
                    self.assertEqual(response.status, 200)
                    return
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.05)
        self.fail("Entry did not become ready within the host startup deadline")

    def test_all_assets_and_source_identity_remain_exact(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.receipt["assetsVerified"], 10)
        self.assertEqual(self.receipt["sourceCommit"], installer.SOURCE_COMMIT)
        self.assertEqual(installer.check_installation(self.destination), self.receipt)

    def test_existing_destination_is_never_overwritten(self):
        before = inventory(self.destination)
        with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), self.destination)
        self.assertEqual(inventory(self.destination), before)

    def test_changed_archive_is_refused_before_destination_creation(self):
        changed = self.root / "changed.zip"
        data = bytearray(Path(ARCHIVE).read_bytes())
        data[-1] ^= 1
        changed.write_bytes(data)
        target = self.root / "must remain absent"
        with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not the pinned"):
                installer.install(changed, target)
        self.assertFalse(target.exists())

    def test_changed_asset_refuses_check_and_server(self):
        target = self.destination / "app/index.html"
        target.write_bytes(target.read_bytes() + b" ")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            installer.check_installation(self.destination)
        child = self.start()
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=6)
        self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("missing or changed", err)
        self.assertNotIn("Tracker:", out)

    def test_symlinked_asset_refuses_check_and_server(self):
        target = self.destination / "app/index.html"
        original = self.root / "same bytes.html"
        target.rename(original)
        target.symlink_to(original)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "regular file"):
            installer.check_installation(self.destination)
        child = self.start()
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=6)
        self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("regular local files", err)
        self.assertNotIn("Tracker:", out)

    def test_launcher_forwards_unexpected_arguments(self):
        child = self.start("--unexpected")
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=6)
        self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("takes no arguments", err)
        self.assertNotIn("Tracker:", out)

    def test_occupied_port_is_preserved(self):
        with socket.socket() as owner:
            owner.bind(("127.0.0.1", 8769))
            owner.listen()
            child = self.start()
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=6)
            self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 1)
            self.assertIn("could not bind", err)
            self.assertNotIn("Tracker:", out)
            self.assertEqual(owner.getsockname(), ("127.0.0.1", 8769))
            with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8769), timeout=1):
                pass

    def test_relocated_unicode_copy_serves_exact_assets_then_enter_stops(self):
        relocated = self.root / "Moved reçu copy"
        self.destination.rename(relocated)
        self.destination = relocated
        child = self.start()
        self.wait_ready(child)
        assets = json.loads((self.destination / "ASSETS.json").read_text())
        for asset in assets:
            with urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8769/" + asset["path"], timeout=3) as response:
                self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(response.read()).hexdigest(), asset["sha256"])
        with self.assertRaises(HTTPError) as caught:
            urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8769/INSTALLATION.json", timeout=3)
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, 404)
        out, err = child.communicate("\n", timeout=6)
        self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("Tracker:", out)
        self.assertIn("Trip checklist:", out)
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            self.assertNotEqual(probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 8769)), 0)

    def test_eof_stops_foreground_server(self):
        child = self.start()
        self.wait_ready(child)
        child.stdin.close()
        child.stdin = None
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=6)
        self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("Tracker:", out)
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            self.assertNotEqual(probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 8769)), 0)

    def source_copy(self, name="source copy"):
        source = self.root / name
        source.mkdir()
        own_installer = source / "install_macos.py"
        own_installer.write_bytes(Path(installer.__file__).read_bytes())
        (source / "serve_returnby.py").write_bytes(
            (ROOT / "tools/received_preview/serve_returnby.py").read_bytes())
        return own_installer

    def test_original_custody_and_installed_runtime_roles_are_exact(self):
        archive, files, _ = installer.admit_archive(Path(ARCHIVE))
        runtime = (ROOT / "tools/received_preview/serve_returnby.py").read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual((self.destination / "recovery/received-build.zip").read_bytes(), archive)
        self.assertEqual((self.destination / "recovery/original-serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(),
                         files["serve_returnby.py"])
        self.assertEqual((self.destination / "serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(), runtime)
        self.assertEqual((self.destination / "recovery/serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(), runtime)
        self.assertNotEqual(runtime, files["serve_returnby.py"])
        self.assertEqual(self.receipt["originalServerSha256"], installer.ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(self.receipt["installedServerSha256"], installer.INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256)

    def test_bad_adjacent_runtime_refuses_before_mkdir_then_corrected_retry_succeeds(self):
        original = (ROOT / "tools/received_preview/serve_returnby.py").read_bytes()
        for kind in ("missing", "directory", "symlink", "changed", "truncated", "oversized"):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                own_installer = self.source_copy("source " + kind)
                runtime = own_installer.with_name("serve_returnby.py")
                runtime.unlink()
                if kind == "directory":
                    runtime.mkdir()
                elif kind == "symlink":
                    target = own_installer.with_name("same bytes.py")
                    target.write_bytes(original)
                    runtime.symlink_to(target)
                elif kind == "changed":
                    runtime.write_bytes(bytes([original[0] ^ 1]) + original[1:])
                elif kind == "truncated":
                    runtime.write_bytes(original[:-1])
                elif kind == "oversized":
                    runtime.write_bytes(original + b"\n")
                destination = self.root / ("corrected " + kind)
                with patch.object(installer, "__file__", str(own_installer)):
                    with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
                        with self.assertRaises((OSError, ValueError)):
                            installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), destination)
                        self.assertFalse(destination.exists())
                        if runtime.is_symlink() or runtime.is_file():
                            runtime.unlink()
                        elif runtime.is_dir():
                            runtime.rmdir()
                        runtime.write_bytes(original)
                        received = installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), destination)
                self.assertTrue(received["accepted"])
                self.assertEqual((destination / "serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(), original)

    def test_admitted_runtime_bytes_are_reused_after_source_changes(self):
        own_installer = self.source_copy()
        runtime = own_installer.with_name("serve_returnby.py")
        admitted = runtime.read_bytes()
        destination = self.root / "admitted before source changed"
        original_mkdir = Path.mkdir

        def change_after_admission(path, *args, **kwargs):
            if path == destination:
                runtime.write_bytes(b"changed after runtime admission")
            return original_mkdir(path, *args, **kwargs)

        with patch.object(installer, "__file__", str(own_installer)):
            with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
                with patch.object(Path, "mkdir", change_after_admission):
                    received = installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), destination)
        self.assertTrue(received["accepted"])
        self.assertNotEqual(runtime.read_bytes(), admitted)
        self.assertEqual((destination / "serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(), admitted)
        self.assertEqual((destination / "recovery/serve_returnby.py").read_bytes(), admitted)

    def test_self_check_refuses_each_changed_runtime_custody_copy(self):
        for name in ("serve_returnby.py", "recovery/serve_returnby.py",
                     "recovery/original-serve_returnby.py", "recovery/install_macos.py"):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                path = self.destination / name
                original = path.read_bytes()
                try:
                    path.write_bytes(bytes([original[0] ^ 1]) + original[1:])
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        installer.check_installation(self.destination)
                finally:
                    path.write_bytes(original)
                self.assertEqual(installer.check_installation(self.destination), self.receipt)

    def test_self_check_refuses_runtime_role_tampering_and_v1_receipt(self):
        path = self.destination / "INSTALLATION.json"
        original = path.read_bytes()
        for field, value in (
                ("originalServerSha256", installer.INSTALLED_SERVER_SHA256),
                ("installedServerSha256", installer.ORIGINAL_SERVER_SHA256),
                ("schema", "returnby-macos-received-preview-v1")):
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                changed = json.loads(original)
                changed[field] = value
                try:
                    path.write_text(json.dumps(changed), encoding="utf-8")
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "receipt does not match"):
                        installer.check_installation(self.destination)
                finally:
                    path.write_bytes(original)
        self.assertEqual(installer.check_installation(self.destination), self.receipt)

    def test_retained_installer_recovers_into_another_new_destination(self):
        original = inventory(self.destination)
        retained = self.destination / "recovery/install_macos.py"
        recovery_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("returnby_recovery_copy", retained)
        recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(recovery_spec)
        recovery_spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
        second = self.root / "Recovered reçu copy"
        with patch.object(recovery.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
            received = recovery.install(self.destination / "recovery/received-build.zip", second)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                recovery.install(self.destination / "recovery/received-build.zip", second)
        self.assertTrue(received["accepted"])
        self.assertEqual(recovery.check_installation(second), received)
        self.assertEqual(inventory(second), original)
        self.assertEqual(inventory(self.destination), original)

    def test_payload_write_failure_retains_partial_copy_without_launcher(self):
        destination = self.root / "partial copy"
        original_open = Path.open

        def fail_payload(path, mode="r", *args, **kwargs):
            if path == destination / "recovery/serve_returnby.py" and mode == "xb":
                raise OSError("controlled recovery payload write failure")
            return original_open(path, mode, *args, **kwargs)

        with patch.object(installer.sys, "platform", "darwin"):
            with patch.object(Path, "open", fail_payload):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "controlled recovery"):
                    installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), destination)
            self.assertTrue(destination.is_dir())
            self.assertFalse((destination / installer.ENTRY_NAME).exists())
            self.assertFalse((destination / "INSTALLATION.json").exists())
            partial = inventory(destination)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), destination)
            self.assertEqual(inventory(destination), partial)
            fresh = self.root / "fresh after partial"
            self.assertTrue(installer.install(Path(ARCHIVE), fresh)["accepted"])

    def test_non_object_receipt_is_a_controlled_cli_refusal(self):
        path = self.destination / "INSTALLATION.json"
        original = path.read_bytes()
        for value in (None, [], 7, "invalid receipt"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                try:
                    path.write_text(json.dumps(value), encoding="utf-8")
                    child = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, "-B", *(["-O"] if sys.flags.optimize else []),
                         str(self.destination / "recovery/install_macos.py"),
                         "--check", str(self.destination)],
                        text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=6)
                    self.assertEqual(child.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(child.stdout, "")
                    self.assertIn("receipt does not match", child.stderr)
                    self.assertNotIn("Traceback", child.stderr)
                finally:
                    path.write_bytes(original)
        self.assertEqual(installer.check_installation(self.destination), self.receipt)

# Install the received completion preview on a Mac

This V2 installer carries the existing ReturnBy completion/checklist build
into a separate, usable Mac folder. It keeps the original ten application assets
unchanged, retains the original foreground server under `recovery/`, and installs
a separately verified runtime supplied beside the installer. A relocatable
`.command` entry uses the Python interpreter that performs installation. It neither builds the web app
nor changes a hosted installation, existing local copy, or saved browser data.

## Use

Use Python 3.12 or later on the intended Mac. The release packet contains the
exact `received-returnby-83abbe9a.zip` input (260,719 bytes; SHA-256
`816e8d09fbecc27ffeb189aa3c889e48e5bc81f352ccc5b75f5cb9bd64badd71`).

```sh
python3 tools/received_preview/install_macos.py \
  --archive /path/to/received-returnby-83abbe9a.zip \
  --destination "/Users/me/Applications/ReturnBy-Completion-20261012-83abbe9a"
```

The separately pinned replacement is 5,744 bytes, SHA-256
`d2bbfaa4440d639bf20e37bc9b0fc3e20d01c643609f1af11d49a57b27e37ac2`.
Keep this installer beside this `serve_returnby.py`; a lone installer or
an original V1 runtime is not sufficient. The destination must not exist.
Installation admits the complete pinned archive and adjacent regular runtime
before creating the destination, uses exclusive directory/file creation, and
writes the executable entry after all payloads and the receipt. A failed or
interrupted install may leave a partial destination. Keep it for inspection and
choose another new path; installation never removes or overwrites it.

Double-click **Start ReturnBy.command**, open either printed address, and press
Enter in its terminal to stop. The fixed origin is `http://127.0.0.1:8769`.
`index.html` opens the tracker; `trip-checklist.html` opens the separate checklist.
The server refuses an occupied port and closes on Enter or EOF. Closing the
server leaves the user's deliberately saved browser records intact. On macOS,
an immediate reopening may print a waiting message while a closed connection
releases the address. Startup waits at most 60 seconds and accepts Ctrl+C to
cancel. Wait for the printed tracker/checklist addresses before opening the app;
a timeout is a refusal, after which the caller can explicitly try again later.

The generated `START-HERE.md` describes the app, stable origin, explicit
backup/restore, verification, and recovery. `recovery/` retains the complete
qualified input, original server, replacement runtime, and exact installer source.
Verify an installed copy with:

```sh
python3 tools/received_preview/install_macos.py --check "/path/to/installed/copy"
```

From an installed folder, the retained installer can create another new copy:

```sh
python3 recovery/install_macos.py --archive recovery/received-build.zip \\
  --destination "/Users/me/Applications/ReturnBy-Completion-Recovered-V2"
```

The recovery installer admits its own adjacent `recovery/serve_returnby.py`.
The exact same verified bytes become both runtime copies in the new destination.
`INSTALLATION.json` uses the `returnby-macos-received-preview-v2` schema and
records separate `originalServerSha256` and `installedServerSha256` fields.
Self-check verifies the original archive/server, all ten assets, both replacement
runtime copies, launcher, guide, and retained installer. V2 deliberately refuses
a V1 receipt; use that original copy\'s retained V1 checker to verify it. Existing
V1 copies and their recovery files are not rewritten.

The existing Mac manual-receipt copy on port 48643 is a separate source generation.
This installer does not update it or automatically migrate its browser storage.

## Source, original receiving, and limits

The application is exact PR37 commit
`83abbe9a00a5169354df25c734c00340ae73ae43`, tree
`cfd56ce9960f08c4f5983d5a7a3ca054373f34c8`. `ASSETS.json` preserves all ten original
built-file pins; it is not a new build receipt. The original producer's native
delivery and independent browser results are recorded in
[PR37 comment 6078634497](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/returnby/pull/37#issuecomment-6078634497).
Application source authors and the #8/#10/#20 final stack owners retain their
existing scopes.

The original portable foreground entry from that MSI delivery was first carried
into this source tree unchanged (3,931 bytes, SHA-256
`7fa92cf4a00072c714e7367feb09fb7f7e2eaa39cf62c9bbef180b303b6191a2`). It was authored
and received by the `2d2d276bbccc/production_custody` team and retains those results
and limits. It is separate from the PR37 application-source commit. The new
installer is `estate-9846061bd2b7/runtime_integration` work; its results are recorded
separately. This V2 successor preserves that source and receiving history while
separating the original runtime custody from the installed runtime. The full
original `PROVENANCE.json` remains in the unchanged transfer archive.

The original application feature campaign is not repeated by entry receiving.
Source publication or a passing non-Mac test does not establish an installed Mac
application, physical desktop use, or wider stack/hosted adoption.

## Focused receiving

The optional standard-library receiver exercises exact assets, refused archive
and asset changes, refused symlinks, exclusive installation, argument forwarding,
an occupied port, a relocated Unicode/spaces path, and real HTTP/Enter/EOF lifecycle.
V2 also exercises absent, changed, linked, nonregular, truncated, and oversized
adjacent runtimes before destination creation; caller-corrected retries; reuse of
admitted bytes after a source change; custody and receipt changes; recovery through
the retained installer; and partial-write refusal followed by a new destination:

```sh
RETURNBY_RECEIVED_ARCHIVE=/path/to/received-returnby-83abbe9a.zip \
  python3 tests/received_preview/test_install_macos.py
```

It reports its actual host. On another operating system only the installation
platform precondition is simulated in a disposable test directory; shell/server
execution still belongs to that actual host. Such a result is not Mac acceptance.
No package manager, browser profile, existing server, dependency, workflow, or
service configuration is modified by these tests.


## Linux foreground restarts

The source foreground entry now enables address reuse on Linux so it can reopen
at the fixed local origin after an HTTP connection closes. It explicitly keeps
port reuse disabled: a second live copy or another active listener still owns
that address and makes this entry refuse to start. Other platforms retain the
original address-reuse setting.

That change first affected directly consumed server source. The original V1
Mac installer admitted the pinned archive and its original server. V2 retains
that archive and original server unchanged while admitting the separately pinned
adjacent replacement described above. Existing installed copies are not rewritten.
The navigation receiving package applies its server source update separately and
records its own manifest hash.

Run the focused Linux lifecycle receiver with an extracted original received
build containing `ASSETS.json` and `app/`:

```sh
RETURNBY_RECEIVED_DIRECTORY=/path/to/received-build \
  python3 tests/received_preview/test_linux_server_restart.py
```

The receiver checks real HTTP/Enter and HTTP/EOF restarts on one unchanged test
port, refusal of a second live copy, and preservation of an existing listener.
`RETURNBY_SERVER_SOURCE` optionally selects an earlier source file for comparison.
Python documents `SO_REUSEADDR` and closed sockets in `TIME_WAIT` in the
[socket module reference](https://docs.python.org/3/library/socket.html#socket.create_server).
